name: powerhouse-delivery-concurrency
purpose: Keep multi-agent development parallel while making the terminal protected landing deterministic, current-main-bound and recoverable.
trigger_when: multiple chats, agents or workflows can move main concurrently
a protected merge is being prepared or retried
main moves during or after exact-head gates
a candidate becomes behind, non-mergeable or conflicted
repeated rebase or retest cycles indicate rising landing-conflict risk
required_behavior: Use one active executable candidate per obligation and reuse the same canonical lineage during recovery.
Parallelize independent development; serialize only the short terminal integration boundary.
Bind terminal landing authority to obligation + exact tested candidate head + exact current main SHA.
Require candidate head to equal tested head, behind_by to equal zero, and GitHub conflict state to be clean before landing.
Re-read current main immediately before protected merge.

If main changes after the relevant gate proof, invalidate the landing proof, reconcile the same candidate onto current main, preserve the full current-main union, rerun exact-head gates and reacquire landing authority.
Use expected-head/CAS semantics for protected merge and treat CAS refusal or merge conflict as recovery input rather than terminal failure.
Use changed-path, contract, dependency and mutable-resource overlap to predict collision risk before terminal landing.
Treat rising behind_by, multiple TERMINAL_DELIVERY candidates, duplicate Obligation-ID, stale merge-base, main movement during gates and repeated reconciliations as leading indicators.
Continue after merge through production/main readback, outcome evidence, learning writeback and skill projection before claiming LIVE & BEWEZEN.
Keep healthy candidate gates running while main moves; reconcile only at the terminal landing boundary unless overlap/conflict invalidates the candidate earlier.
At terminal landing, coalesce drift into one freshest-main full-union reconciliation, then rerun exact-head gates once.
Order multiple ready disjoint candidates by shortest remaining terminal critical path and downstream fan-out cost while preserving one-at-a-time landing authority.
forbidden_patterns: treating a green candidate on an older main epoch as currently merge-authorized
opening a fresh same-obligation PR solely because main moved
serializing all development when only the final landing boundary conflicts
merging a candidate with behind_by greater than zero
bypassing branch protection or required gates after a race
claiming completion at merge without readback and canonical writeback
